$comment: The rows of the dataset release at schema 2 (docs/v2.md), one JSON object per line of tengoku-dataset.jsonl.gz. Not the schema of data/ records (record.schema.json). A field that does not apply is left out, never null (headline: left out unless true). scripts/v2.py check enforces this file; the two are kept equal by scripts/tests/test_v2.py.

row.ref: <library>:<name>, or <library>:<name>~<10 hex digits of the statement's sha256>, with .2, .3 ... when even that ties; unique in the dataset
row.legacy_name: a proper prefix of name: what schema 1 said where it cut the name
row.module: the Lean module of the .lean file source_url points into
